passage_1:
http://www.tradetoolreview.com/washers/aquajet-p5

★★★★☆

By: Desmond Achebe
Date: 3 April

I run a small business, Gleamworks Valeting, and I recently bought four AquaJet P5 cordless pressure washers for my cleaning team. We work on customers’ driveways and forecourts, so my staff are moving between properties all day long.

The pressure is impressive for a cordless unit, and the nozzle set is genuinely useful for awkward wheel arches. However, the water tank is rather small. My employees have to stop and refill it several times during a single job, which slows down their workflow slightly.

Despite this minor inconvenience, the extended battery life is a huge plus. When my team turn up at properties with long driveways, they can finish the whole job without stopping to recharge. Overall, I think the money spent on these machines was a sound investment.
